people.name: Sanjay D’Souza
people.role: Group Head – Business Banking, Emerging & Micro Enterprises Group and a Senior Management Personnel
people.bio: Mr. Sanjay D’Souza has superannuated from the services of the Bank with effect from the close of business hours on October 31, 2026 and has accordingly ceased to be the Group Head – Business Banking, Emerging & Micro Enterprises Group and a Senior Management Personnel of the Bank.
